2.a: (1) Rahul's dominant factor — social, specifically aspirational reference-group influence from his team lead as an opinion leader, (2) His sister's dominant factor — psychological, the internalised belief that expensive means better quality, a price-quality heuristic, (3) The difference — his decision bends to external social pressure while hers springs from an internal cognitive shortcut.
